config.enabled.name: Block second staircase
config.enabled.tooltip: Once you placed a staircase on a mine level, further staircases on that level are blocked unless you hold the override key.
config.override-key.name: Override key
config.override-key.tooltip: Hold this while placing to put down another staircase anyway.
config.show-hint.name: Show hint
config.show-hint.tooltip: Show a short message when a staircase placement was blocked.
